role: Development pilot after whole-query switch learnability failed E1.2.
source_population: The same 419 complete financial development tasks.

mutually_exclusive_strata.stable_specialist: At least one non-anchor model exceeds qwen-plus by >0.05 in at least two repeats; rank by maximum mean specialist advantage.
mutually_exclusive_strata.stable_anchor: qwen-plus is the unique winner in all three repeats and task is not stable_specialist; rank by minimum repeated margin over the strongest competitor.
mutually_exclusive_strata.unstable: Per-repeat canonical winner is not identical across all three repeats and task is in neither prior stratum; rank by winner entropy then mean top-two margin ascending.

decomposition.mode: deterministic input-only templates by observable table presence

candidate_pool_reason: E1.2 found the strongest observable learnability for GLM versus qwen-plus; two-model measurement minimizes calls.

measurement_plan.advance_to_all_120_only_if: subtask stable gap exceeds matched whole-query stable gap and harmful-switch opportunity is below 0.25

manifest_gate: exactly 120 unique tasks and 480 unique nodes
all dependencies exist and graph is acyclic
final composition node exists exactly once
no gold, evidence, response, score, dataset, or task_type fields in node prompts
external_call_policy: Manifest construction is offline. Candidate execution requires configured provider credentials and explicit cost-bearing execution availability.
